verdict.rationale: Scribe documents an optional Text Polishing step that improves punctuation, capitalization, grammar and readability. The polished text is returned separately under outputs.text_polishing.text while the original transcript is never overwritten, so a developer can choose formatted or unformatted output. The evidence does not say whether base transcripts include punctuation and casing by default, and it never mentions number formatting (inverse text normalization) or a dedicated switch to disable formatting. Missing for 10: evidence of default punctuation/casing on raw transcripts, number formatting, an explicit formatting on/off parameter, and independent corroboration.
